privacy: Allowlisted metrics only. No credentials, private chat IDs, conversation/answer/reasoning bodies, workspace paths, profile-topic filenames, response headers or initial login passwords.
measurement_notes: first_token_ms may include non-visible model activity; first visible content is reported separately.
native_driver_ms includes driver and streaming wall time; non_driver_residual_ms is subtraction, not CPU time and not an exclusive filesystem attribution.

NFS and XFS isolated runs are sequential rather than randomized paired trials; production data was not moved.
Deterministic loopback-model fixture verifies scheduling and I/O mechanisms only; its one-token usage is synthetic.
Chromium latency_ms is an emulation parameter, not measured packet RTT.
Implementation snapshots identify measured code; no implicit claim that a later fix or deployment was measured.
